source: Piet Mondrian, Composition with Blue, Red, Yellow, and Black, 1922. Minneapolis Institute of Art, mia_4001106_800.jpg (sRGB IEC61966-2.1 embedded).
method: black rules located by column/row dark-fraction; each field sampled >=8 px inside its rules; value = per-channel median of the interior (n = 4,900-251,370 px). k-means (k=5) over the canvas agrees within JPEG/edge noise.
